Notes: Dungeon Dogs merc recruiter (Enforcer). Placed in PlayfieldContent 4582/6553/4310 Npcs.json. {hiremerc} hires a pet-based Enforcer companion at the player's level (one per profession, in memory only).

hire.Text: I'd like to hire a Enforcer.

hello.Text: Looking for some muscle? I can sign a Enforcer on to watch your back. No charge for newcomers.

hire.Text: Done. Your Enforcer will follow you and fight what fights you.{hiremerc enforcer}

busy.Text: Sorry, I can't send anyone out right now.

dismiss.Text: {dismissmercs}All right, I'll call them back. Come see me any time you need them again.

how.Text: You can hire one of each kind: Doctor, Enforcer, Soldier and Keeper. They work like pets, so use the pet window or /pet commands to tell them to follow, guard, wait or attack. They leave when you log off or fall in battle; just come back and hire them again.
